description: Read the current Amazon buy box price, list price, stock status, seller, and rating for ASINs or product URLs on 9 marketplaces, priced for that marketplace's delivery country. Keeps the last reading between runs and returns a change row when a price moves or a product goes out of or back into stock. Costs 0.0056 USD per product on amazon.com and amazon.ca, 0.015 USD elsewhere, plus a run start.

marketplace.description: The store a bare ASIN is read from.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Summary rows are always returned.

previous_snapshot.description: Optional. Rows from an earlier run of this actor, as a JSON list. When given, changes are computed against these rows, not the stored readings.

products.description: ASINs or Amazon product URLs, up to 1,000 per run. A URL uses the marketplace in the URL; a bare ASIN uses the Marketplace setting.

proxy_mode.description: auto (default): amazon.com and amazon.ca are read through the Apify proxy pool with residential as the fallback; other marketplaces use residential addresses in that country, because Amazon prices for the delivery country. residential: every product uses residential addresses in its marketplace country and is billed as product-row-local.

state_key.description: Optional name for the set of last readings, when you keep several separate tracking lists. Letters, numbers, dots, dashes, underscores.

track_changes.description: true (default) or false. With true, the actor keeps each product's last reading in a key value store in your account, and a later run writes a change row when the price moves or the product goes out of or back into stock.

name: track_amazon_products
title: Read Amazon price and stock
